summary:
NULL dereference in the SCRAM server when a client sends channel-binding
data and the application registered none. The vulnerable code is not in
2.1.28: upstream fixed it by 45d66335 (NULL check on sparams->cbinding in
scram_server_mech_step2()), released in 2.1.28 as d0f9021e on the 2.1
branch. The 2.1.28+dfsg1 orig tarball carries the check and no Debian or
Echo patch touches plugins/scram.c.
